Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Siddhartha Sinha, learned counsel for the
complainant, Shri Piyush Kumar Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to
enlarge her on bail in Case Crime No. 476 of 2021 under Sections 147, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506
I.P.C., Police Station- Thakurganj, District- Lucknow.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the present case as during the course of investigation, arrest of the applicant was protected by the Writ Court, thereafter, charge-sheet was filed on 20.10.2022 by Investigating Officer.
He further submits that an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. was filed, thereafter, interim anticipatory bail was granted by this Court to the applicant on 28.09.2022.

However, they do not dispute the fact that during the course of investigation, arrest of the applicant was protected by the Writ Court,
thereafter, interim anticipatory bail was granted to the applicant on 28.09.2022.
5.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A., learned counsel for the complainant and going through the contents of the bail application as well as other relevant enclosures; it is evident that on 28.09.2022, interim anticipatory bail was granted to the applicant.

Order dated 28.09.2022 is as under:
"Heard Sri Syed Husain Abbas, learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and Sri Siddharth Sinha, learned Advocate, who has filed Vakalatnama on behalf of the complainant/ opposite party no.2.
Said Vakalatnama is taken on record.

As per learned counsel for the applicant, the present applicant is apprehending her arrest in Case Crime/ FIR No.476 of 2021, under Sections 147, 420, 467, 468, 471,
504 & 506 IPC, Police Station - Thakurganj, District - Lucknow.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the present applicant has been falsely implicated in the case as she has not committed any offence as alleged.

Attention has been drawn towards the order dated 06.09.2021 passed by this Court in Misc. Bench No.19682 of 2021; Smt. Nafees Fatima & Others vs. State of U.P. &
Others, whereby the Division Bench of this Court has granted interim protection to the applicant till the next date of listing directing the applicant to participate in the investigation.

sentences.text: Learned counsel has submitted that however, the aforesaid writ petition is still pending but when the charge sheet has been filed, learned trial court has issued summon and bailable warrant against the present applicant, then she filed her anticipatory bail application before the learned court below, which has been rejected on 13.09.2022.
Therefore, the present applicant is apprehending her arrest in the aforesaid case crime, however, her writ petition is pending.

Sri Abbas has further submitted that in compliance of the order dated 06.09.2021 (supra) passed by the writ Court, the present applicant has cooperated with the investigation and has never flouted the process of law, therefore, her liberty may be protected till conclusion of the trial proceedings.
Further, the applicant undertakes that she shall cooperate with the trial proceedings.
Per contra, learned AGA as well as Sri Siddharth Sinha has opposed the aforesaid request of learned counsel for the applicant.

Sri Sinha has submitted that the present applicant has not filed all relevant documents with this application and while getting Smt. Nafees Fatima vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188832434/

sentences.text: (i) The applicant shall not commit or participate in any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which she is suspected.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the Trial Court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the Trial Court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against her in accordance with law.
8. The trial court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously in accordance with law without giving any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.

Let counter affidavit be filed within a period of three weeks.
List this case on 19.10.2022.
As an interim measure, applicant- Smt. Nafees Fatima is granted interim anticipatory bail in the aforesaid case crime number.
Therefore, the applicant is directed to furnish her personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.50,000/- each before the learned trial court, and shall participate in the trial proceedings, with the following conditions:-
1. that the applicant shall make herself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
2. that the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence;
3. that the applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the court;
4. that the applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness;
5. that the applicant shall appear before the trial court on each date fixed unless personal presence is exempted.
When the case is next listed, name of Sri Siddharth Sinha shall be printed in the cause list as counsel for the complainant/ opposite party no.2."
6. Subject to above, the bail application is allowed.
